note_title: 函数在任何可测集合上积分为0意味着函数几乎处处为0
in_subset_via: an epsilon of room证明集合为0测度的策略

callouts.id: 函数在任何可测集合上积分为0意味着函数几乎处处为0#1
callouts.title: 命题1
callouts.body: $(X,\mathcal{F},\mu)$是一个测度空间如果可测函数$f:X\to \mathbb{R}$满足$$\int_E f \,d\mu =0 $$对任意$E \in \mathcal{F}$成立,那么$f =0$几乎处处成立。

classification_result.id: 函数在任何可测集合上积分为0意味着函数几乎处处为0#1

if_problem.statement_en: Let $(X,\mathcal{F},\mu)$ be a measure space. If a measurable function $f:X\to \mathbb{R}$ satisfies $$\int_E f \,d\mu =0$$ for every $E \in \mathcal{F}$, then $f=0$ almost everywhere.
key_techniques: decomposition into positive and negative parts
testing the integral on level sets
prerequisites: positive and negative parts of a function

callouts.id: 函数在任何可测集合上积分为0意味着函数几乎处处为0#2
callouts.title: 练习1
callouts.body: 用同样的方式证明$C_{\varepsilon}:=\{x\in X:f^{-}>\varepsilon\}$对任意$\varepsilon$也是零测度的。

classification_result.id: 函数在任何可测集合上积分为0意味着函数几乎处处为0#2

if_problem.statement_en: Prove in the same way that for every $\varepsilon$, the set $C_{\varepsilon}:=\{x\in X:f^{-}>\varepsilon\}$ also has measure zero.
key_techniques: use level sets of the negative part
contradiction via nonzero integral on a positive measure set
prerequisites: positive and negative parts of a function
